coverage.note: Coverage describes inspected repository-observable testing candidates only; undiscovered tests may still exist and zero evidence does not establish that tests are absent or that the repository is release ready.

limitations.summary: Test pass/fail status is not evaluated.
Runtime code coverage is not measured.
Framework detection is limited to supported declarations and structural indicators.
Test-type classification is based on repository conventions and explicit configuration.
Test effectiveness and assertion quality are not evaluated.
Remote CI execution history is not inspected.
Disabled or skipped markers are collected without judging whether they are justified.
Fixture and test-data content is not evaluated.
Generated, vendored, binary, unsupported, or oversized files may be excluded.
No conclusion about release readiness can be drawn.
